name: Unicode Soft Hyphens
description: Adds and highlights Unicode soft hyphens in plain-text inputs for better line breaking.
project_description:
Sometimes you want to indicate where words should break as css hyphens sometimes breaks words in ugly ways.

That's where soft hyphens is needed. But some fields don't allow ­ to be used so that we developed the Unicode Soft Hyphens

 Features 
 Unicode Soft Hyphens provides the possibility to add soft hyphens in title fields where you can't add html ­ . Instead it will add a unicode character for this and visualize it as it is normally invisible.

 It is not necessary to add a new field for this and works with existing title fields of nodes or blocks.

 Configuration 
 Go to the settings of your content type or block type and find the "Unicode Soft Hyphens settings". Enable it for the title field of the content type or block type.

On the edit form of your content or blocks you will now find a small button next to the title label to insert soft hyphens by unicode.
